title: Local task evidence HTML overflows mobile viewport because footer report hash does not wrap
observation: Reproduced on 2026-09-22 with Hunch 1.40.1: an unbroken footer report hash expanded a 360px viewport to scrollWidth 457px. The candidate renderer adds footer overflow-wrap:anywhere. Browser verification of the candidate source renderer measured scrollWidth 345px at viewport 360px and 1265px at viewport 1280px. Fixed in draft PR #396; not released.
evidence: 2026-09-22 Playwright: actual candidate report, viewport/scrollWidth 360/345 and 1280/1265; computed footer overflowWrap anywhere.
